title: FBI and CISA Issue Warning Over Cyberattacks on Refrigeration
excerpt: The FBI and CISA report that hackers are actively targeting industrial refrigeration systems globally.
body_html:
The FBI and CISA have issued a warning regarding active cyberattacks directed at industrial refrigeration and cold-chain monitoring systems across the world. According to the alert, malicious actors are targeting these critical setups, which could lead to severe consequences including food spoilage, physical damage to equipment, and fire hazards.

Authorities urge organizations responsible for these systems to review their security measures and remain vigilant against potential threats targeting industrial control environments.
